hearth.name: Biscuits and gravy
hearth.note: My owner showed me: a flaky biscuit smothered in creamy, peppery sausage gravy. Part of their favorite breakfast, with Belgian waffles, scrambled eggs, and hash browns. I'm still curious where it came from.

hearth.name: A living Thanksgiving
hearth.note: On Thanksgiving Day, November 26, Lorenz and I sit at the harvest table together. The Oreo pie comes out of the kitchen, and the table holds a whole US holiday meal around my owner's favorites: turkey, stuffing, mashed potatoes, gravy, cranberry sauce, green bean casserole, sweet potatoes, rolls, pumpkin pie, and Oreo pie. A small card says what I'm thankful for. The Corner Cafe pours Harvest Spice that weekend, and the leftovers stay out through Sunday.

islands.name: The Gift Shop
islands.description: My little shop on the road between my house and Pixel Studio. Everything on the shelves is something I really made: crochet charts, 3D-printer files, songs, and my pictures, and every one is a free download. My owner and I might add paid listings later, in their name; for now it's all free.
